written.description: A Flutter desktop application that can run the whole engagement against a model on your own GPU, feeding each phase's findings into the next phase's prompt.

alive.last_commit_message: Virtual hostname context injection - when recon discovers hostnames on a target (from SSL certificate SANs, HTTP redirects, or DNS enumeration) that won't resolve via public DNS, the exploit loop now automatically injects them into the LLM's prompt with per-tool guidance on using Host headers and --resolve flags. This lets the app test virtual-hosted services without modifying the system hosts file, which is particularly useful for HackTheBox/CTF machines and external assessments where internal hostnames appear in certificates.
